cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: I’ve Done This Before
cards.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. We'll have this tent up before the rain. I'm familiar with these sleeves. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: This one has clips. The poles cross first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Yes, the clip system. Cross the poles; then we attach the fabric.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That fabric's the outer cover. We're standing on the inner tent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly. Step off the inner tent and we'll raise it first. I always lay everything out.

mechanism: A leads tent setup with performed familiarity, converting B construction clues into commands while accepting B conditions for continued assistance.
confusable: Unlike merely issuing correct instructions, A first reveals a wrong assumption and learns from B; confidence needs B cooperative participation.
comparison: Shared shelter under approaching rain differs from coffee service and guest cup settings.
seedUse: Use D42-b sleeves/clips/inner tent clues and S02-a claiming corrections as planned steps.
